title: Limitations.
officialText:
Temporary signs constructed of combustible materials shall not extend more than 12 inches (305 mm) over, or
into, a street.
Exceptions:
1. When permitted by the Department of Transportation, temporary signs of combustible materials may be suspended
from buildings or poles to extend across streets.
2. Temporary signs of combustible materials constructed without a frame may be attached flat against, or suspended
from, the fascia of a canopy or marquee, provided that the lowest part of any such sign is at least 9 feet (2743 mm)
above the ground or sidewalk level.
SECTION BC H117
REFERENCED STANDARDS
